caption: Toda-Yamamoto Granger F-statistics at lags 1–12, both directions. Petroleum Stocks → SPY (vermillion) clears the 5% critical line at lags 6, 7, and 8 (min p = 0.030); SPY → Petroleum Stocks (pale blue) clears it at none. This supports a 6-12 month lead band, not a pinpointed 12-month causal horizon.
narrative_alignment_note: Forward direction rendered as the visually primary series; caption reconciles Granger 6-8 month cluster with L12 winner.
